300.title: Poland among EU’s top packaging exporters
300.summary: Poland is among Europe’s top producers and exporters of packaging products, overtaking major producers such as France and Italy, a new report shows. The Polish packaging sector is one of the country’s most significant industrial successes, analysts from Poland's second-largest bank by assets, Bank Pekao, said.
300.body: Poland is among Europe’s top producers and exporters of packaging products, overtaking major producers such as France and Italy, a new report shows. The Polish packaging sector is one of the country’s most significant industrial successes, analysts from Poland's second-largest bank by assets, Bank Pekao, said. According to the bank's data, Poland holds a dominant position in wooden packaging, accounting for approximately 21 percent of all EU exports. Low-cost Chinese competition poses the primary threat, and Chinese products now make up nearly 10 percent of Poland's total packaging imports.

400.summary: Japan’s Kansai acquires 40 pct stake in Polish OWP Saturday, November 21 2026 Acquisition Japan’s Kansai Electric Power has signed an agreement to acquire a 40 per cent stake in Ocean Winds’ 390 MW BC-Wind offshore wind project in Poland.
400.body: Japan’s Kansai acquires 40 pct stake in Polish OWP Saturday, November 21 2026 Acquisition Japan’s Kansai Electric Power has signed an agreement to acquire a 40 per cent stake in Ocean Winds’ 390 MW BC-Wind offshore wind project in Poland. This is Kansai’s first business investment in Poland Under the share purchase agreement the Japanese company signed with Ocean Winds, Kansai will acquire the stake in C-Wind Polska, the special-purpose company established for the project, through its wholly owned subsidiary KPIC Netherlands. BC-Wind is being developed in the Polish Baltic Sea, approximately 23 kilometres off the coast of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The project will comprise 26 Siemens Gamesa wind turbines with a rated capacity of 14 MW each and a Power Boost feature that can increase their output to 15 MW.

The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision .
400.body: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision . The payment to Poland for the already greenlighted milestones and targets can take place following the EFC’s positive opinion and the subsequent adoption of a payment decision by the Commission. With a view to the closure of the Recovery and Resilience Facility at the end of 2026, Members States had to implement all outstanding milestones and targets by the end of August 2026 and submit final payment requests by the end of September 2026.
